items.title: 20.1.1 Benzene ka thermodynamic istehkaam aur resonance (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 20.1.1, printed pages 57-58.

blocks.text: Alkenes ki tarah benzene mein bhi double bonds hain, lekin benzene alkenes se kahin zyada stable (mazboot, aasani se na badalne wala) hai. Is ka saboot hydrogenation (hydrogen jorna) mein nikalne wali heat (hararat) naap kar milta hai. Benzene aur cyclic alkenes ki heats of hydrogenation se pata chalta hai ke kaun sa compound kitna stable hai. Har reaction mein catalyst par hydrogen jurne se aakhir mein cyclohexane hi banta hai. Neeche wale diagram mein cyclohexane neeche wali (kam energy wali) reference line hai. Aayein mukhtalif cyclohexenes ki heats of hydrogenation dekhein.

blocks.alt: Energy level diagram: energy oopar ki taraf aur cyclohexane neeche ki lakeer. Is ke oopar levels: farzi (hypothetical) cyclohexatriene 360 kJ/mol, 1,3-cyclohexadiene 240 kJ/mol, benzene 208 kJ/mol aur cyclohexene 120 kJ/mol; har aik ke saath us ki ring aur cyclohexane tak neeche teer.
blocks.caption: Figure 20.1: Cyclohexenes aur benzene ki hydrogenation ka energy level diagram (kitab ki Figure 20.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Har level cyclohexane se apni qeemat (value) ki oonchai par bana hai: farzi cyclohexatriene 360, 1,3-cyclohexadiene 240, benzene 208 aur cyclohexene 120 kJ/mol.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har level cyclohexane se apni value jitna ooncha hona chahiye: cyclohexatriene 360 (farzi, hypothetical), cyclohexadiene 240, benzene 208, cyclohexene 120 kJ mol⁻¹. Kitab ki tasveer mein labels apni lines par nahi: 1,3-cyclohexadiene aur benzene 240 wali line se oopar, aur cyclohexene 208 wali line se oopar chhape hain. Yahan har level sahi jagah par bana hai. Benzene ummeed (360) se 152 kJ mol⁻¹ kam heat deta hai; yahi resonance energy hai.

Cyclohexene ki hydrogenation se cyclohexane banta hai aur 120 kJ mol⁻¹ energy nikalti hai. Is hisaab se cyclohexadiene (do double bonds) se 240 kJ mol⁻¹ aur farzi (hypothetical) 1,3,5-cyclohexatriene (teen double bonds) se 360 kJ mol⁻¹ ki ummeed hai, jaisa Figure 20.1 mein hai. Agar benzene bhi aisa hi teen double bonds wala ring hota to us ki heat of hydrogenation bhi cyclohexatriene jitni (360) hoti. Lekin benzene ki heat of hydrogenation bohat kam (208 kJ mol⁻¹) hai; yeh dikhata hai ke benzene ghair mamooli taur par stable hai. Yeh heat ummeed se 152 kJ mol⁻¹ kam hai. Is ka matlab hai ke benzene farzi cyclohexatriene se kahin zyada stable hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan likhti hai ke heat ummeed se “158.5 kJ mol⁻¹” kam hai. Kitab ki apni values se 360 − 208 = 152 kJ mol⁻¹ banta hai, aur agle paragraph mein kitab khud 152 kJ mol⁻¹ likhti hai. Sahi: 152 kJ mol⁻¹.

Is stability ki wajah π electrons ki delocalisation (phail jana) hai. Modern concept ke mutabiq benzene ke tamam π electrons chhe ke chhe carbon atoms ke π orbitals ke overlap se poore ring par phaile hue hain. Benzene ki asal heat of hydrogenation theoretical (hisaab wali) value se 152 kJ mol⁻¹ kam hai. Is energy ko benzene ki resonance energy (delocalisation energy) kehte hain. Delocalisation ka concept agle topic (20.1.2) mein samjhaya gaya hai.

blocks.title: Resonance aur resonance energy
blocks.text: Benzene ka asal structure Kekule ke kisi ek structure jaisa nahi; yeh un ke darmiyan ek delocalised structure hai. Ise resonance kehte hain. Resonance (delocalisation) energy woh izafi stability hai jo benzene ko farzi cyclohexatriene (alag alag double bonds) ke muqable mein milti hai: 360 − 208 = 152 kJ mol⁻¹.

blocks.prompt: Heats of hydrogenation se dikhayein ke benzene ki resonance energy 152 kJ mol⁻¹ hai.
blocks.explanation: Teen double bonds ki ummeed: 3 × 120 = 360 kJ mol⁻¹. Benzene ki naapi gayi value: 208 kJ mol⁻¹. Farq: 360 − 208 = 152 kJ mol⁻¹.

items: Cyclohexene 120, farzi cyclohexatriene 360, benzene sirf 208 kJ mol⁻¹.
Resonance energy = 152 kJ mol⁻¹: benzene ummeed se zyada stable hai kyun ke us ke π electrons delocalised hain.
